describes: Hymnary.org print of 'Alas! and Did My Savior Bleed', photographed on a desk. Three staff systems, five verses stacked under them, and the chords pencilled in by hand above the staves. The hardest kind of page this app sees: handwriting, low contrast, and slash chords split as 'Ab /G'.

expect.title: Alas! and Did My Savior Bleed
